narrative.overview: A calm, well-lit working surface with an ink frame; blue is for action; depth is layered and quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutrals, one blue accent, ink for identity.
Tabular, scannable numbers; the measure is always named.
Missing values are a dash, not a zero.
Depth by tone and hairline first, shadow second.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means you can act here or this is selected.

rules.name: The Name-the-Measure Rule
rules.body: A number is never shown without its measure, round and party or question.

dos: Do name the measure, round and party or question beside every number.
Do show a dash for missing values.
donts: Don't show real survey figures in decoration.
Don't use pp in any label.
